# Update Implementation Plan

Use this fallback skill to revise existing plans without losing context.

## Procedure
1. Compare current plan against new requirements.
2. Update milestones, scope boundaries, and sequencing.
3. Record changed assumptions and risk posture.
4. Publish the revised plan with explicit deltas.
